name: nibgrid-studio
description: Local-first 2D game asset foundry, sprite composer, shader studio, TileMapLayer prototyper, Godot 4 res:// sync, and MCP tool suite for VS Code, Cursor & Google Antigravity IDE.

commands.title: Nibgrid: Sync Diff to Godot res://

nibgrid.updates.autoCheck.description: Automatically check GitHub Releases for Nibgrid Studio Desktop updates every 24 hours.

languageModelTools.name: nibgrid_inpaint_sprite_region
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inpaint a masked pixel region of an existing Nibgrid sprite asset.

languageModelTools.name: nibgrid_repalette_sprites
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Quantize and snap sprite colors to the active Art Bible palette in OKLab space.

languageModelTools.name: nibgrid_update_gdshader_uniforms
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Update uniform values on a Godot 4 .gdshader preset for a Nibgrid sprite.

languageModelTools.name: nibgrid_add_or_move_socket
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Create or reposition a Godot Marker2D attachment socket on an entity sprite.

languageModelTools.name: nibgrid_recompute_colliders
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Recompute simplified 2D convex hull colliders, hurtboxes, or hitboxes from sprite alpha.

languageModelTools.name: nibgrid_generate_sfx_cue
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Synthesize a deterministic procedural WAV sound effect cue for an entity action.

languageModelTools.name: nibgrid_patch_room_layout
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Place tiles, entities, or spawn markers inside an M35 TileMapLayer room blueprint.

languageModelTools.name: nibgrid_sync_godot_diff
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Compute SHA-256 diff and synchronize updated Nibgrid assets into Godot res://.

languageModelTools.name: nibgrid_run_vertical_slice
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Run the single-prompt Nibgrid Vertical Slice Autopilot DAG to assemble res://main.tscn.
